title: The Patient Bell
author: Edmund Ishikawa
blurb: Ada Almeida, an urban explorer mapping tunnels that aren't on any survey, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. But when the childhood imaginary friend is waiting on the porch, unchanged, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must learn the song's last verse without singing along, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
